full_prompt_en: A square figurative painting shows an older costumed man and a younger woman seated close together beside a table crowded with food. A deep reddish-brown wall fills the background, giving the brightly colored figures a theatrical enclosure. At the left, the older man wears a red coat with gold trim and broad shoulder details over a pale garment. A white cloth is tied around his head, and his weathered face carries a heavy mustache and an animated, slightly upward expression. One hand rests on the white fabric spread across his lap. The younger woman leans against him from the center, her head tipped toward his shoulder. She wears a white blouse with full sleeves and a dark fitted bodice. Her dark hair falls back from a softly lit face, and one hand touches her cheek as she looks up and out of the picture. Her dark trousers and high tan boots extend toward the lower center, overlapping the man's pale clothing. On the right, a small table covered with a brilliant yellow cloth holds bread, red fruit, a glass, and other small dishes, painted in brisk, clustered marks. A larger pile of brown produce rises behind it against the dark wall. The floor is only partly visible under the figures, with warm tiles and deep shadows grounding the seated pose. Light comes from the upper left and front, striking faces, blouse, white lap fabric, and yellow cloth; the wall stays dim and warm. Brushstrokes remain visible, especially in fabric folds and still-life details, with firm dark contours alternating with loose patches of color. The overall composition is intimate yet staged, balancing a pair of expressive faces against rich red, white, and yellow color masses.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形具象绘画呈现一名穿戏服的年长男子与年轻女子紧挨着坐在堆满食物的桌边。深红棕色墙面填满背景，为色彩明亮的人物形成舞台般的围合。左侧年长男子穿饰有金色边饰与宽肩细节的红外套，里面是浅色衣服。白布包住头部，风霜面容留着浓重胡须，表情生动而微微向上。一个手掌放在腿上铺开的白布上。年轻女子从中央倚向他，头偏向他的肩。她穿蓬袖白衬衫与深色合身马甲。深发从受柔光照亮的脸旁向后垂，一只手碰着脸颊，目光向上并望向画外。深色裤子与高筒棕靴伸向下部中央，遮挡男子的浅色衣服。右边，一张铺鲜亮黄桌布的小桌上摆着面包、红色水果、玻璃杯和其他小碟，用迅疾而聚集的笔痕画成。更大一堆棕色食物在其后靠着暗墙升起。人物下方仅见部分地面，暖色砖块和深影固定坐姿。光从左上和前方照来，落在面部、上衣、腿部白布和黄桌布上；墙面保持昏暗而温暖。笔触仍可辨，尤其在衣褶与静物细节处，坚实深轮廓与松散色块交替。整体构图亲密却有舞台感，让两张有表情的脸与浓厚的红、白、黄色团块平衡。
style_prompt_en: The figurative painting uses strong theatrical color blocks and visible brushwork rather than seamless realism. Deep wine-red and brown form a quiet enclosing field; bright white, saturated red, and warm yellow pull the main masses forward. Faces receive tighter modeling than surrounding fabric or incidental detail, so expressive centers stay clear within loose paint. Broad folds are built from broken light and dark strokes, and adjacent objects merge where their values are close. A warm directional light catches selected upper planes while leaving corners dense and shadowed. Overlapping forms create intimate shallow depth, with a compact still-life cluster serving as a secondary color anchor. The surface feels worked and tactile, not polished flat. The overall effect is dramatic and human, combining bold massing, lively painterly edges, and carefully placed warm highlights.
style_prompt_zh: 这种具象绘画使用强烈的戏剧性色块和可见笔触，而非无缝写实。深酒红与棕色形成安静围合底域；亮白、饱和红与暖黄把主要体量推向前方。表情中心比周围布料和附带细节塑形更紧，因此在松散颜料中仍清楚。宽大衣褶由破碎明暗笔痕构成，明度接近的相邻物件会彼此融并。暖定向光抓住局部上表面，让角落浓重而阴暗。互相遮挡的形体建立亲密的浅纵深，紧凑静物簇充当第二色彩支点。表面有反复经营的触感，不是抛光平面。整体效果戏剧性且富人情味，结合大胆体量安排、活跃绘画边缘和审慎落下的暖色高光。
theme_en: An older costumed man and a younger woman leaning together beside a laden table
theme_zh: 一名着戏服的年长男子与年轻女子靠坐在摆满食物的桌旁
name: Paula Rego
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
